texts.value: Plays an important role in the regulation of dynamic actin-based, cytoskeletal activities. Agonist-dependent changes in LASP1 phosphorylation may also serve to regulate actin-associated ion transport activities, not only in the parietal cell but also in certain other F-actin-rich secretory epithelial cell types (By similarity)
Interacts with F-actin (By similarity). Interacts with ANKRD54 (By similarity). Interacts with KBTBD10
Associated with the F-actin rich cortical cytoskeleton
